goal: Guards contrib/devtools/gen-manpages.py so it refuses to generate manpages when the build lacks HAVE_SYSTEM, ENABLE_WALLET, or ZMQ support, preventing contributors from committing incomplete manpages.
reviewability: Reviewable but stalled: no author or maintainer activity resolving an open naming-convention question since 2026-04/05, well past the 60-day silence threshold.

result.summary: This PR adds a guard to contrib/devtools/gen-manpages.py that reads the generated bitcoin-build-config.h and refuses to generate manpages if HAVE_SYSTEM, ENABLE_WALLET, or WITH_ZMQ are disabled, printing a hint to rebuild with the right options. It also adds a new WITH_ZMQ cmakedefine to the build config header template so the ZMQ option can be checked the same way as the other two. An environment variable, SKIP_BUILD_OPTIONS_CHECK, allows bypassing the guard.
result.problem: Contributors who build without wallet, ZMQ, or system() support can unknowingly generate and commit incomplete manpages, as tracked in issue #17506. This duplicates an earlier attempt (#33085) that stalled and was closed.

open_concerns: maflcko is unsure whether reusing the CMake option name WITH_ZMQ directly as a #cmakedefine is good practice or 'triply confusing', and wants build-system-expert input.
A related PR #35072 may address the same naming/config-header topic, potentially superseding or informing this one.
Author has repeatedly pinged fanquake/hebasto for a naming opinion since March 2026 without a response.
resolved_concerns: Earlier version's HAVE_SYSTEM check never worked because CMakeCache.txt doesn't contain HAVE_SYSTEM; author switched to reading the build config header directly, which maflcko found plausible (lgtm ACK).
Argparse vs env-var inconsistency (--skip-build-options-check vs SKIP_BUILD_OPTIONS_CHECK) was resolved by dropping the argparse option and standardizing on the env var.

result.card: This PR adds a safeguard to contrib/devtools/gen-manpages.py that checks bitcoin-build-config.h and refuses to generate manpages unless HAVE_SYSTEM, ENABLE_WALLET, and WITH_ZMQ are all enabled, so contributors don't accidentally commit incomplete manpages, fixing issue #17506. It replaces an earlier stalled attempt (#33085) that was closed for inactivity. The author went through several failed implementations, including one where a maintainer noted 'HAVE_SYSTEM is never present in CMakeCache.txt, so I don't see how this could work' and questioned whether the code was AI-generated, before landing on reading the build config header directly, which drew a stale lgtm ACK from maflcko. The PR is now stalled on an unresolved naming question (reusing the CMake option name WITH_ZMQ as a #cmakedefine, which maflcko called 'triply confusing') that maintainers have not answered since April 2026, and a related PR #35072 may touch the same design. Impact is narrow: this affects only the correctness of a release-time documentation tool, not core node behavior.
